Intellect

You see a pattern where others see only trouble, and trust your understanding enough to act.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Knowledge, Reason; HP contribution +2. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Scholarship, Craft, Medicine, Mind.

Discipline pricing: Home: Scholarship, Craft. Adjacent: Medicine, Mind. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.4f39449eb00ee792.JournalEntryPage.9b5b247d3812bd50]{Spot the Leverage} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b3ab9788a1d1e6e2.JournalEntryPage.81a3c26503b2049d]{Make the Connection} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.e8277dfee39a8706.JournalEntryPage.1de0dc54e8481740]{Prepared Explanation}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2451d237a7a9f09a.JournalEntryPage.d6e26597c054e857]{A Better Angle} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.8de91f503b922976.JournalEntryPage.78461ff38c196ac8]{Diagnose the Failure} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2a4d6b84dfe7bbc5.JournalEntryPage.7f3416181261a956]{Predict the Motion}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.135a629fe571f61a.JournalEntryPage.86f6dcac9cd7e5cd]{A Route for Everyone} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.6e763cd1e831a8e9.JournalEntryPage.7248aa1e82cc44c4]{Test the Hypothesis} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.c8711ce55f61acdd.JournalEntryPage.64b8af3f33fcecd8]{Expose the Mechanism}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Find leverage, connect evidence, or give useful directions. - Level 3: Direct an ally, diagnose mechanisms, or predict an attack. - Level 7: Route the party, reconstruct events, or expose a target for allies.

Starting coin contribution: +8 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
